The Lighthouse at Cape Verde

The old lighthouse stands at the edge of the cliff, where the sea meets the sky. Every evening the keeper climbs the long spiral stair to light the lamp. Ships far out on the water steer by its steady beam and reach the harbour safely.

In winter the storms are fierce and the waves crash against the rocks below. The keeper writes the weather in a small book and reads it aloud to the radio. By morning the sea is calm again, and the gulls return to the old stone wall.

Figure 1. The lighthouse seen from the north shore at dusk.
